decisions.reason: As a multi-model safety shoe line in the firm's core category, it likely embodies meaningful development and production investment, so management would be inclined to give it more time rather than reverse course quickly.

The comfort insole is more peripheral and less visibly promoted than the main footwear lines, but it still complements the core offer and recent launch costs make management more likely to retain it for now.

The supportive insole appears to be a lower-visibility accessory that could be rationalized if needed, yet escalation of commitment and its fit with the footwear system argue for keeping it another year.
An ergonomic safety shoe series with its own page signals a visible commitment in a central product area, which makes German management especially likely to persist despite any early uncertainty.

Firefighter and rescue boots are a specialized but still core protective-footwear line, and the investment in several models would usually justify continued market presence while results are still attributable to ramp-up effects.
Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship and shown on the home page, management is strongly committed publicly and strategically and is therefore very unlikely to withdraw it soon.
